summary:
Implementation plan for Al Hidayah Audio:
1. Diagnosis and resolution of the GitHub Pages blank white screen and 404 asset errors.
2. Capacitor Android packaging configuration, Android project generation, and APK build workflow setup.
3. Dual-layer offline audio storage engine (Capacitor Filesystem on Android, IndexedDB Blob Store on Web/PWA).
4. Audio player online/offline rules, connection detection, Bengali offline error toast, and React ErrorBoundary.
5. Verification, build checks, and comprehensive testing matrix.
